answer: The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the lantern of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. By the inlet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
